description: This file defines the OAuthClient entity class used within the OrangeHRM system to represent OAuth2 client data in a database, including properties like client ID, secret, redirect URI, and status flags.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'ohrm_oauth2_client' table, representing OAuth client data including client ID, secret, redirect URI, and status flags.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID used for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret, if any, used for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: setClientSecret
methods.description: Sets the client secret for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI for OAuth 2.0 callbacks.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for OAuth 2.0 callbacks.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: setConfidential
methods.description: Sets the confidentiality status of the client.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the OAuth client.
